keywords.label: flow
keywords.documentation: Directs a data stream through declarative transformation stages: `flow dataset into sift(valid) into tally();`.

keywords.label: into
keywords.documentation: Connects processing stages in a dataflow pipeline: `into sift(...) into map(...)`.

keywords.label: sift
keywords.documentation: Filters a data stream intuitively: `sift items where value > 0`.

keywords.label: tally
keywords.documentation: Aggregates count or sum across a stream: `let total = tally items where active;`.

keywords.label: mesh
keywords.documentation: Splits a stream into parallel pipelines and converges results: `mesh stream { diverge a; diverge b; converge; }`.

keywords.label: spawn
keywords.documentation: Launches an asynchronous concurrent worker: `let task = spawn { compute(); };`.

keywords.label: detach
keywords.documentation: Launches a detached task that runs to completion independently without needing a join handle.

keywords.label: await_all
keywords.documentation: Waits on multiple asynchronous tasks to complete simultaneously: `let [a, b] = await_all(t1, t2);`.

keywords.label: await_any
keywords.documentation: Races multiple asynchronous tasks and resolves with the first completed result: `let fastest = await_any(t1, t2);`.

keywords.label: signal
keywords.documentation: Declares a typed event signal that can be emitted and listened to across threads and fibers.

keywords.label: listen
keywords.documentation: Listens for broadcasts of a given event signal: `listen EventName as ev { ... }`.

keywords.label: every_interval
keywords.documentation: Executes recurring periodic tasks cleanly: `every_interval 1.second { poll(); }`.

keywords.label: guard
keywords.documentation: Enforces a condition with guaranteed early exit on failure: `guard ready else { return 0; }`.

keywords.label: ensure_clean
keywords.documentation: Guarantees resource teardown execution even during stack unwinding or error recovery.

keywords.label: isolate_fault
keywords.documentation: Sandboxes untrusted or volatile execution so panics or hardware traps do not bring down the program.

keywords.label: sealed
keywords.documentation: Prevents inheritance or external modification of a struct or module layout.

keywords.label: interrupt_gate
keywords.documentation: Defines a hardware interrupt service routine with automatic CPU register state saving and restoration.

keywords.label: cpu_port_in
keywords.detail: Hardware Port I/O Read (x86 inb) (C> v2.1.1)
keywords.documentation: Reads a byte directly from a hardware CPU I/O port for kernel and bootloader development.

keywords.label: cpu_port_out
keywords.detail: Hardware Port I/O Write (x86 outb) (C> v2.1.1)
keywords.documentation: Writes a byte directly to a hardware CPU I/O port for peripheral hardware control.

keywords.label: cache_flush
keywords.documentation: Flushes CPU cache lines for coherent DMA and memory-mapped hardware synchronization.

keywords.label: dma_transfer
keywords.detail: Direct Memory Access Controller Burst (C> v2.1.1)
keywords.documentation: Triggers hardware DMA controller burst data transfers without CPU cycle consumption.

keywords.label: say
keywords.documentation: Simpler and cleaner than Python print: outputs text and values directly to console. Parentheses are optional: `say "Hello"` or `say(x)`.

keywords.label: ask
keywords.documentation: Simpler than Python input: prompts the user and assigns directly into a variable: `ask "What is your name? " -> user_name`.

keywords.label: repeat
keywords.documentation: Repeats a block N times without verbose range generators: `repeat 5 times { say "Hi!" }`.

keywords.label: every
keywords.documentation: Iterates through elements of any array, list, or stream: `every item in collection { say item }`.

keywords.label: whenever
keywords.documentation: Clean, human-readable conditional execution: `whenever condition { ... } otherwise { ... }`.

keywords.label: otherwise
keywords.documentation: Accompanies `whenever` to execute when condition is false: `otherwise { say "Alternative" }`.

keywords.label: define
keywords.documentation: Defines functions intuitively with automatic type inference: `define greet(name) { say "Welcome, " + name }`.

keywords.label: given
keywords.documentation: Intuitive declarative pattern matching: `given status { when "active" -> say "Running" }`.

keywords.label: when
keywords.documentation: Branch inside a `given` block: `when condition -> action`.

keywords.label: attempt
keywords.documentation: Attempts execution safely and catches any trouble: `attempt { ... } trouble err { say err }`.

keywords.label: trouble
keywords.documentation: Catches and handles failures from an `attempt` block.

keywords.label: check
keywords.documentation: Checks a condition and halts with clear message if false: `check count > 0, "Must have items"`.

keywords.label: hold
keywords.documentation: Pauses execution for a duration: `hold 500.ms` or `hold 2.seconds`.

keywords.label: bootstrap
keywords.documentation: Directs the C> autonomous compiler to parse, analyze, and build itself into a standalone native binary without needing any C compiler or intermediary.

keywords.label: emit_binary
keywords.documentation: Generates a fully standalone native binary executable directly from byte streams or IR, completely bypassing C.

keywords.label: emit_native
keywords.documentation: Emits direct machine code instructions targeting the active CPU architecture.

keywords.label: byte_stream
keywords.detail: Machine Code / Byte Stream Assembler (C> v2.1)
keywords.documentation: Constructs native machine opcodes and binary sections for self-compilation.

keywords.label: lex_stream
keywords.documentation: Tokenizes C> source text natively for autonomous parsing.

keywords.label: parse_tree
keywords.documentation: Constructs and traverses the abstract syntax tree for self-compilation.

keywords.label: target_arch
keywords.documentation: Sets the hardware CPU target (e.g. x86_64, aarch64, riscv64, wasm32).

keywords.label: sym_table
keywords.documentation: Manages identifiers, types, scopes, and memory offsets during compilation.

keywords.label: link_native
keywords.documentation: Links native object sections directly into executable format (ELF / Mach-O / PE / WASM).

keywords.label: lowlevel
keywords.documentation: Explicit opt-in block for direct hardware control, MMIO, register mapping, and low-level memory operations. Keeps everyday code clean and beginner-accessible.

keywords.label: opt_hardware
keywords.documentation: Enables direct peripheral access, hardware registers, and architectural intrinsics.

keywords.label: raw_register
keywords.documentation: Reads or writes to physical microcontroller/CPU registers.

keywords.label: mmio_map
keywords.documentation: Maps physical device memory address space for direct memory operations.

keywords.label: fence_sync
keywords.documentation: Enforces hardware memory ordering (e.g. seq_cst, acquire, release).

keywords.label: direct_reg
keywords.documentation: Accesses CPU hardware status registers (e.g. CR0, RFLAGS, CONTROL).

keywords.label: bit_slice
keywords.documentation: Extracts or writes specific bit ranges without manual bitmasks: `bit_slice(val, 0, 7)`.

keywords.label: endian_swap
keywords.documentation: Swaps endianness (big-endian <-> little-endian) using dedicated single-cycle CPU instructions.

keywords.label: bare_metal
keywords.documentation: Configures code to run without an operating system, suitable for kernel bootloaders and firmware.

keywords.label: spec
keywords.documentation: Declares mathematical specifications and formal properties to be statically checked or runtime-asserted.

keywords.label: contract
keywords.documentation: Defines software contracts containing pre-conditions (`requires`), post-conditions (`ensures`), and invariants (`invariant`).

keywords.label: requires
keywords.documentation: Specifies a boolean precondition that must be true before entering the associated function or scope.

keywords.label: ensures
keywords.documentation: Specifies a boolean postcondition guaranteed to hold upon exit from the associated function or scope.

keywords.label: invariant
keywords.documentation: Specifies an invariant condition that remains universally true across state changes.

keywords.label: nexus
keywords.documentation: Declares a lock-free or buffered concurrent communication nexus between tasks or hardware pipelines.

keywords.label: quantum
keywords.documentation: Begins a lightweight cooperative execution quantum that can yield execution explicitly using `yield_to`.

keywords.label: yield_to
keywords.documentation: Yields control from current quantum fiber to the specified target fiber or runtime scheduler.

keywords.label: region
keywords.documentation: Creates a scoped memory arena. Allocations inside the region are fast pointer bumps and freed in O(1) time at scope boundary.

keywords.label: morph
keywords.documentation: Safely reinterprets a raw byte stream or contiguous span into a typed header or packet without allocation.

keywords.label: isolate
keywords.documentation: Enters an uninterruptible hardware isolated critical execution section with interrupts masked.

keywords.label: hazard
keywords.documentation: Protects a pointer from concurrent deallocation during lock-free data structure traversal.

keywords.label: claim
keywords.documentation: Claims and pins a hazard pointer value, preventing epoch reclamation during reader execution.

keywords.label: pin
keywords.documentation: Pins a variable or reference to a fixed physical address or MMIO register.

keywords.label: gpu_kernel
keywords.documentation: Marks a function as a GPU compute kernel to be compiled to Vulkan SPIR-V, CUDA PTX, or Metal MSL.

keywords.label: gpu_dispatch
keywords.documentation: Dispatches a GPU kernel across a 1D, 2D, or 3D compute grid.

keywords.label: defer
keywords.documentation: Defers execution of the statement or block until the enclosing scope exits.

keywords.label: own
keywords.documentation: Specifies exclusive affine heap ownership with no aliasing. Can only be moved, never cloned implicitly.

keywords.label: lent
keywords.documentation: Represents an explicitly lent resource whose caller guarantees borrow lifetime without lockups.

keywords.label: ref
keywords.documentation: Creates a safe shared reference to a value.

keywords.label: vector
keywords.documentation: Fixed-width SIMD hardware vector of element type T and lane count N (e.g. vector<f32, 4>, vector<i32, 8>).

keywords.label: device_span
keywords.documentation: Non-owning view over contiguous memory accessible from both CPU host and GPU device.
